entries.reason: money() is deliberately unsupported: SharpMUSH does not track pennies (function answers '#-1 NOT SUPPORTED').
PennMUSH reports its attribute-chunk allocator; SharpMUSH stores attributes in its database and has no allocator to report.
entries.profile: PennMUSH's file and allocator housekeeping answers `NOT SUPPORTED`

entries.reason: PennMUSH checks the password and would wipe its own log file; SharpMUSH's logs go to configured sinks the game does not own, so @logwipe refuses before any password check.
entries.profile: PennMUSH's file and allocator housekeeping answers `NOT SUPPORTED`

entries.reason: PennMUSH gives a STICKY room's drop-to move to SYSEVENT (#-1 as the handler sees it); SharpMUSH has no SYSEVENT object and passes on the player whose leaving caused the move.
entries.profile: A drop-to move's event names who caused it

entries.reason: PennMUSH forwards silently and counts the recipient it tried; SharpMUSH reports the refusal and counts the recipients the message reached.
PennMUSH refuses a MAILFILTER folder name the player has not used yet; SharpMUSH creates the folder and files the message.
entries.profile: Folders are named freely and created on delivery

entries.reason: PennMUSH reads an empty MAILFORWARDLIST as a list naming nobody and drops the mail; SharpMUSH treats it as no list and delivers normally.
